in_marathi.name: Sharveshwari
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Knowledge
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sharveshwari हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। She who is the embodiment of wisdom and knowledge, revered as the goddess of learning and education. She is also known as the goddess of power, strength, and knowledge.
